meaningsEn: (formal) and; together with (linking parallel nouns, verbs, or phrases)

(formal) with; from (marking the other participant in an interaction, comparison, or contrast, e.g. 與他握手|与他握手[yu3 ta1 wo4 shou3] "shake hands with him", 與去年不同|与去年不同[yu3 qu4 nian2 bu4 tong2] "different from last year")
(literary) to give; to grant; to bestow
